anna_sec: Heads-up — vendor wants a retest next Wed 10:00-14:00 PT. Need to lock an access window, KMS proxy plan, RBAC temp roles, and auditstream snapshot policy. Who can own evidence ingestion and presigned URL flow?
javier: I can own evidence ingestion. Plan to upload to a timeboxed S3 bucket and provide presigned URLs. Q: will the vendor need KMS decrypt permissions or should we proxy decryption?
mike_infra: Proxy is safer. Recommend envelope encrypting artifacts with our KMS and giving vendor presigned URLs for the ciphertext only. They never get Decrypt. We can run a small KMS-proxy service for limited ops. Example config snippet to create ephemeral role:```yaml apiVersion: v1 kind: ServiceAccount metadata: name: assessor-temporary namespace: pen-test```
tia_prodsec: Audit requirements: we must collect authz decisions + request/response headers for any API calls used in the test. Vendor asked for 30d retention, security policy requires 90d. Proposal: staging=60d, prod=90d, and export a 90d compressed snapshot for assessors.
dmitri: For RBAC, do NOT edit existing policies in-place during the window. Create an "assessor-readonly" role bound to a short-lived session via OIDC + MFA. Revoke the role at the end of the window and rotate any session credentials.
sre_bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-pt-5367 to provision temp bucket + presigned-url lifecycle (12h expiry). :white_check_mark:
anna_sec: small correction — it's me (anna_sec) not "nanna". Also: Javier, can you set presigned URLs to 12h and require SHA256 checksum on upload? We need chain-of-custody.
javier: Yep — 12h expiry and checksum requirement. Will add a signed metadata manifest with uploader identity.
mike_infra: Also enable CloudTrail data events for S3 and KMS, and point CloudTrail to our auditstream (Kafka topic). Command to enable data events:```aws cloudtrail put-event-selectors --trail-name prod-trail --event-selectors '[{"ReadWriteType":"All","DataResources":[{"Type":"AWS::S3::Object","Values":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pen-test-evidence/*"]},{"Type":"AWS::KMS::Key","Values":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/pen-test-key"]}] } ]'```
tia_prodsec: Add a header field trace-id to the test requests so we can correlate logs <-> evidence. Also, we need integrity proofs: sign manifest with our internal signing key before handing to vendor.
dmitri: Post-window rollback playbook: 1) revoke assessor-role, 2) rotate any service account tokens used by the proxy, 3) remove presigned URL grants, 4) snapshot and upload auditstream export to secure archive. I'll draft a runbook.
anna_sec: Mike — can you draft the KMS-proxy runbook and a minimal deployment manifest? Include health checks and a kill-switch to cut access if vendor misbehaves.
mike_infra: On it. Minimal kube deploy + liveness:```kubectl apply -f kms-proxy-deploy.yaml``` I'll add an emergency toggle that flips a ConfigMap to denyall.
sre_bot: incident-bot: scheduled retention job to snapshot auditstream at +72h post-window and push compressed export to archivist. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/pen-test-retention
tia_prodsec: One more: we need proof-of-access logs (who assumed the assessor role + IP + MFA assertion). Add that to the manifest.
javier: I'll capture uploader identity and attach MFA assertion in the manifest JSON. Example manifest fields: { "uploader":"javier", "role":"assessor-readonly", "mfa_serial":"arn:aws:iam::111:mfa/javier", "sha256":"..." }
dmitri: I'll own revocation verification during the post-window check. Plan to run a dry-revoke at T+1h to verify automation works.
anna_sec: Great. Action items summarized: Javier = evidence ingestion + presigned URLs + manifest; Mike = KMS-proxy + CloudTrail + deploy manifest; Dmitri = RBAC temp role & revocation runbook; Tia = audit retention & trace-id. I'll own coordination and vendor comms.
mike_infra: FYI — I'll open a PR with the proxy helm chart and a sample CloudTrail policy by EOD.
javier: Starting the S3 bucket provisioning now. Will update INFRA-pt-5367 with bucket name and presigned URL test sample.
tia_prodsec: Thanks. tagging compliance: @legal-team we may need a short addendum for evidence handling — can someone from legal confirm storage constraints?
sre_bot: legal-bot: pinged legal-team for confirmation on retention and cross-border transfer rules.
anna_sec: Closing loop: we'll run a 30-min dryrun next Tue 09:30 PT to validate manifests and presigned URL flow. Please be available. :thumbsup:
